news.title: Unlocking opportunities: A family’s guide to college financial aid and scholarships
news.summary_en: Financial aid can be confusing. Here's a guide covering the options available and how to get them to help you and your college-bound teen.

news.title: All hands on deck: UNI nursing students join area responders for simulated emergency
news.summary_en: At UNI, nursing students are gaining hands-on experience in emergency preparedness right on campus. A simulated mass casualty incident tested how students and area responders can come together when a large disaster occurs with limited resources.

news.title: What drives the cost of Thanksgiving dinner? A UNI economist explains
news.summary_en: Robin Chen, assistant professor in macroeconomics in the Wilson College of Business, explains the forces shaping Thanksgiving prices and what consumers might expect next.

news.title: McLeod Center turns 20
news.summary_en: The arena opened on November 18, 2006 with a crowd of 5,522 watching UNI volleyball sweep Bradley. Not only is the facility home to athletics events, but it also hosts commencements and community gatherings.

news.title: No major? No problem. These students found their way at UNI
news.summary_en: It's totally OK to not have your major figured out when you first get to college. In fact, it's pretty common. Check out these students' experiences in UNI's Exploratory Program.
